limitations: This single-AI, gold-visible post hoc review is descriptive, not independent human adjudication or a new official score.
Same-candidate prose can preserve meaning while violating the verbatim definition contract; matching a name is weaker evidence than returning a full definition.
Correct-candidate content under absent or insufficient source context does not establish justified disambiguation.
